flows.title: Needs-you inbox loads and separates audit events from operational executions
steps: 1. Open http://172.22.149.245:40823/preview/pv_4ff96dd95373d2e3c1458bd0a8/ in a 1440x1000 viewport.
2. Navigate to the Needs You inbox view.
3. Select a task card that has recovery history (at least one repair round).
4. Read the counters shown on the card and in its detail panel.
expected: The inbox renders without console errors or an error banner.
Audit events and operational executions are shown as two separately labeled counters, never a single combined number.
Restart replay entries are labeled as uncharged and are not added to the operational execution counter.
The attempt ordinal shown matches the task's attempt record and is not equal to the number of recovery journal entries when those differ.

flows.title: Multi-node lineage shows task-local counters and lineage-wide generation
steps: 1. From the inbox, open the lineage view for a lineage that has three linked nodes (predecessor, successor, second successor).
2. On each of the three nodes read the repair round, operational execution count, retry total, audit total, and reconciliation generation.
3. Check the dependency list on the lineage view for any unrelated dependency node.
expected: Each node shows its own repair round (first node 1, second 2, third 3) and its own operational execution count (4, 8, 10 on the seeded lineage).
Retry totals and audit totals differ per node; no node repeats another node's values.
The third node shows reconciliation generation 3.
No unrelated dependency carrying an execution count of 99 appears anywhere in the lineage view.

flows.title: Lineage and statistics views reject malformed identifiers
steps: 1. Open http://172.22.149.245:40823/preview/pv_4ff96dd95373d2e3c1458bd0a8/ and navigate to the lineage view.
2. Edit the URL to replace the lineage identifier with the string wft_bogus%00 and load it.
3. Repeat with an empty identifier segment and with an identifier longer than 200 characters.
4. Open the statistics view and append a date-range query with end before start.
expected: Each malformed lineage request shows a friendly not-found or validation message; the page does not crash or show a blank screen.
No stack trace, internal path, or raw 500 error text is displayed.
The statistics view with an inverted date range shows a validation message and keeps the previous valid statistics visible.
Browser console shows no uncaught exceptions.

flows.title: Runtime bundle invalidation emits exactly one fast_path_fallback event
steps: 1. Open the task detail for a task whose reconciliation bundle was invalidated at runtime.
2. Open its events or timeline tab.
3. Type fast_path_fallback into the event filter input.
4. Clear the filter and inspect the plan section and the executor edits list.
expected: Exactly one reconciliation.fast_path_fallback event is listed for the task.
The plan section shows the replacement full-pipeline plan, not the pruned plan.
The executor edits list contains no edits attributed to the discarded pruned plan.

flows.title: Incremental reconciliation shows pruned plan and sealed manifest, full pipeline on any doubt
steps: 1. Open the task detail for a task that completed incremental reconciliation.
2. Open the reconciliation or plan tab and read the plan and manifest fields.
3. Open a second task whose inputs were flagged changed, missing, digest-mismatched, or vacuously verified.
4. Read the plan selection shown for the second task.
expected: The first task shows a pruned plan listing only affected rows and a manifest marked sealed with a generation number.
The second task shows a full pipeline selection with the stated reason (changed, missing, digest mismatch, guarded, ambiguous, or vacuous verification).
Reloading either page shows the same plan selection, confirming it was persisted.

flows.title: Successor minting produces one successor and retains needs_merge predecessor until landing
steps: 1. Open the task detail for a predecessor task in needs_merge state that has a minted successor.
2. Read the predecessor status and its outgoing dependency edges.
3. Follow the link to the successor and read its bundle and routing sections.
4. Open a predecessor whose successor has already landed and read its status.
expected: The unlanded predecessor is still present with status needs_merge and is not hidden or deleted.
Exactly one successor is linked; the successor shows a single frozen bundle with one digest.
Each dependent edge appears once pointing to the successor, with no duplicate edge rows.
The predecessor whose successor landed shows status resolved.

flows.title: Reconciled candidate requires fresh verification and human approval
steps: 1. Open the task detail for a reconciled candidate awaiting approval.
2. Open the gates or checks panel.
3. Read the verification, adversarial review, judge and browser acceptance, and approval rows.
4. Observe the approval control but do not click it.
expected: Verification row shows Ran true, Passed true, at least one executed required command, and no admission error.
No gate is shown as satisfied by predecessor evidence or preauthorization; each is marked fresh for this candidate.
Human approval is shown as pending and is a distinct step before landing.
The landing step is disabled or not offered until approval is recorded.

flows.title: Needs-you-inbox evidence row passed with three outputs and prompt teardown
steps: 1. Open the verification or evidence view for the current task.
2. Locate the row named needs-you-inbox.
3. Read its status, duration, and listed outputs.
4. Open each of the three linked images.
expected: The row shows passed with no text containing context deadline exceeded or capture failed.
Three outputs are listed: light, dark, and narrow.
The light and dark images render at 1440x1000 and the narrow image at 560x1000.
Row duration is within the evidence-row deadline shown for the row.

flows.title: Auto-recovering conflict scenario shows Automation in progress header
steps: 1. Open the Needs You inbox with the auto-recovering-conflict scenario selected or seeded.
2. Wait for the card to finish loading.
3. Read the card header text.
expected: The header reads Automation in progress 1.
The card does not show a stale header from a previous scenario.
No loading spinner remains after the header appears.

flows.title: Inbox filter input handles invalid and hostile values
steps: 1. Open the Needs You inbox.
2. In the filter or search input, enter the string <script>alert(1)</script>.
3. Clear it and enter a 2000-character string of the letter a.
4. Clear it and enter only whitespace.
5. Clear it and enter a task id that does not exist.
expected: No alert dialog appears and the text is displayed escaped or ignored.
The long value does not freeze the page; the list shows an empty or unchanged result.
Whitespace-only input shows the unfiltered list.
The nonexistent id shows an empty state message, not an error page.

flows.title: Inbox renders at narrow width and in dark theme
steps: 1. Open the Needs You inbox at 1440x1000 and switch the theme control to dark.
2. Resize the viewport to 560x1000.
3. Scroll the inbox list top to bottom.
4. Load the inbox URL with a theme query parameter set to bogus.
expected: Dark theme applies to the header, cards, and counters with readable contrast.
At 560px width there is no horizontal scrollbar and counters remain visible on each card.
The bogus theme value falls back to the default theme without an error.

flows.title: Statistics view keeps audit and operational counts separate and task-local
steps: 1. Open the statistics view.
2. Locate the recovery section and read the audit event total and operational execution total.
3. Select a single task from the statistics breakdown and read its per-task counters.
4. Compare the per-task numbers with the same task's inbox card.
expected: Audit and operational totals are shown in separate columns or rows and are not equal to each other's sum.
Per-task counters match the inbox card for that task and do not include another task's values.
Restart replay entries are labeled uncharged in the breakdown.
